_comment: Brand profile template. Copy this folder to <PROJECT_ROOT>/brands/<slug>/ and fill it in. Only name and colors.primary/accent are required; the agent infers the rest itself (references/brands.md). Paths are relative to the brand folder (assets/…) or to the project.
name: ⟨YOURS: brand name⟩
description: ⟨YOURS: what the brand does, who the videos are for⟩
language: ⟨YOURS: brand language code, for example en, ru or th⟩
voice: ⟨YOURS: the brand voice in 1–2 lines, for example “calm expertise, specifics instead of promises”⟩

logos.on_dark: assets/⟨logo for a dark background and over video⟩.png
logos.mark_on_dark: assets/⟨compact mark for the frame corner⟩.png

forbidden_imagery: ⟨YOURS: imagery not allowed in the frame, in the brand's language⟩
forbidden_imagery_en: ⟨the same in English, for English-language searches and prompts⟩
forbidden_words: ⟨YOURS: promises and clichés that are not allowed⟩
music_policy: do not burn in without a commercial license; pick the track in the app when publishing
